full_prompt_en: A square religious portrait painting centers a gray-haired, white-bearded older man in deep red ceremonial clothing against a richly patterned rust and gold background. The figure faces directly forward from the waist up, with his shoulders broad across the lower half of the frame and his stern gaze meeting the viewer. Behind his head, a large circular halo is built from many fine concentric marks, while rectangular and round ornamental panels fill the wall on both sides. His hair is wavy, pale gray, and slightly disordered at the temples. Strong brows, deeply set eyes, creases on the forehead, and a full tapered beard give the face a weathered, sharply observed surface. An embroidered pale stole curves around the shoulders and descends in a long decorated band down the center of the chest. Its cream, faded gold, and terracotta patterns include circular medallions and small interlocking shapes, standing out against the dark crimson robe. A narrow gold staff rises near his left side, partly cropped by the lower edge. His hands appear low and only partly visible, leaving the face and ornamental chest panel as the clear points of attention. The paint has a granular, aged finish, with fine linework in the symbols and broader textured modeling in skin and cloth. Warm light from the upper left illuminates the forehead, white beard, and embroidery; the right side of the face and red sleeves descend into deep brown shadow. The frontal symmetry is softened by asymmetrical light and small irregularities of hair and fabric. The overall composition feels grave and intimate, holding a realistic human presence inside a dense, timeworn field of sacred red and gold decoration.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形宗教肖像画把一位灰发白须的年长男子置于锈红与金色纹样繁密的背景前，身穿深红礼仪服饰。人物从腰上正面入画，宽阔双肩占据下半部，严肃目光直望观者。他头后是一圈由许多细密同心痕迹构成的巨大光环，两侧墙面铺满矩形与圆形装饰区块。头发呈淡灰色波浪状，两鬓略显蓬乱。浓眉、深陷眼睛、额头皱纹和饱满渐尖的胡须，使面容既经风霜又刻画明确。一条浅色刺绣披带环绕肩部，并沿胸前中央垂成长长的装饰带。其奶油白、褪金和陶土色纹样包含圆形饰章及细小交锁形状，在深绯红袍服前十分突出。一根细金色手杖在他左侧升起，被下边缘局部裁去。双手位于低处，仅有部分可见，使面容与胸前纹样成为最明确的注意点。画层呈颗粒感与古旧效果，符号部分以细线刻画，皮肤和布料则用较宽的带肌理明暗塑造。左上方暖光照亮额头、白须和刺绣；面容右侧与红色衣袖进入深棕阴影。正面的对称结构被不对称光线及发丝、衣料的细小不规则处柔化。整体构图庄重而亲密，把真实的人物存在置于密集、历经岁月的红金色神圣装饰之中。
style_prompt_en: A richly textured painted treatment combines realistic, directional modeling at the center with flat, repetitive ornament around it. Deep crimson and rusty umber dominate broad areas; faded gold, cream, and terracotta filigree create smaller luminous patterns. Edges vary from finely drawn decorative lines to softer, grainier transitions across rounded forms. Dense circular and rectangular motifs sit behind a calm frontal silhouette, lending order without making the surface flat. Warm upper-left illumination picks out pale raised details and leaves the opposite side in brown-black shade. The aged granular finish unifies material and background, while the contrast between focused human-scale modeling and patterned surrounds creates a solemn visual hierarchy. The image feels weighty, intimate, and timeworn.
style_prompt_zh: 肌理丰厚的绘画处理把中央具有方向性的写实体积塑造，与周围平面化重复装饰结合起来。深绯红和锈棕占据大块区域；褪金、奶油白和陶土色细纹组成较小的发光图案。边缘从精细描绘的装饰线，变化到圆润形态上更柔和、更粗粒的过渡。密集圆形与矩形纹样置于平静正面剪影背后，带来秩序而不使表面扁平。左上暖光挑亮浅色凸起细节，另一侧则留在棕黑阴影中。古旧颗粒完成面统一材料与背景，集中塑形和周围纹样之间的反差建立庄严的视觉层级。画面厚重、亲密而历经岁月。
theme_en: A solemn gray-bearded cleric before a patterned red and gold wall
theme_zh: 红金纹样墙前神情肃穆的灰胡须神职人物
name: Catholic icon
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
